const DefaultWidth untyped int = 80

const ImagesBlocks ImageMode = 1

const ImagesITerm2 ImageMode = 3

const ImagesKitty ImageMode = 2

const ImagesNone ImageMode = 0

const ImagesSixel ImageMode = 4

const MaxWidth untyped int = 1000

func (m ImageMode) String() string

func (t *Theme) Dark() bool

func (t *Theme) Name() string

func DefaultTheme(dark bool) *Theme

func HTML(src string, o HTMLOptions) (string, error)

func LoadTheme(name string, dirs ...string) (*Theme, error)

func ParseImageMode(s string) (ImageMode, error)

func ParseTheme(name string, r io.Reader) (*Theme, error)

func Render(src string, o Options) (string, error)

func Themes(dirs ...string) []string

type HTMLOptions struct {
	CommonMark bool
	NoMath bool
	Unsafe bool
	Standalone bool
	Title string
	Theme *Theme
}

type ImageMode uint8

type Options struct {
	Width int
	Theme *Theme
	Color bool
	TrueColor bool
	Hyperlinks bool
	Images ImageMode
	ImageRows int
	CellWidth, CellHeight int
	BaseDir string
	CommonMark bool
	NoMath bool
	NoDiagrams bool
}

type Theme struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}

var ErrTooLarge = errors.New("render: document larger than 16 MiB")

var ErrUnknownTheme = irender.ErrUnknownTheme
